description: This file defines the SmsReadPlatformService interface, which declares methods for retrieving SMS data and statuses from the platform, including fetching all SMS records, specific records, pending, sent, delivered, failed messages, and data based on various filters.

classes.name: SmsReadPlatformService
classes.description: Interface defining methods for reading SMS data within the platform.

methods.name: retrieveOne
methods.description: Retrieves a single SMS data record by its resource ID.

methods.name: retrieveAllPending
methods.description: Retrieves all pending SMS data records associated with a specific campaign ID, limited by specified count.

methods.name: retrieveAllSent
methods.description: Retrieves all sent SMS data records, limited by specified count.

methods.name: retrieveAllDelivered
methods.description: Retrieves all delivered SMS data records, limited by specified count.

methods.name: retrieveAllFailed
methods.description: Retrieves all failed SMS data records, limited by specified count.

methods.name: retrieveSmsByStatus
methods.description: Retrieves SMS data filtered by status, campaign ID, date range, and search parameters, paginated.

methods.name: retrieveExternalIdsOfAllSent
methods.description: Retrieves external IDs of all sent SMS messages, limited by specified count.

methods.name: retrieveAllWaitingForDeliveryReport
methods.description: Retrieves IDs of messages waiting for delivery reports, paginated.

methods.name: retrieveAllPending
methods.description: Retrieves IDs of all pending SMS messages, limited by specified count.
